description: This Java source file defines the EntityListIterator class, which implements a cursor-based iterator for handling database query results within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for navigating, retrieving, and managing result sets of GenericValue objects, supporting features like partial list retrieval, size estimation, and resource management.

classes.name: EntityListIterator
classes.description: A cursor-based iterator for traversing database query results of GenericValue objects, supporting navigation, partial retrieval, size estimation, and resource management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator instance used for database operations.

methods.name: afterLast
methods.description: Moves the cursor to just after the last row in the result set.

methods.name: beforeFirst
methods.description: Moves the cursor to just before the first row in the result set.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the last row of the result set.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the first row of the result set.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: currentGenericValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current row as a GenericValue object.

methods.name: currentIndex
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position index.

methods.name: absolute
methods.description: Moves the cursor to an absolute row position.

methods.name: relative
methods.description: Moves the cursor relative to its current position.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there is a next element in the result set.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if there is a previous element in the result set.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next row and returns it as a GenericValue.

methods.name: nextIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next element.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Moves to the previous row and returns it as a GenericValue.

methods.name: previousIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the previous element.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the result set.

methods.name: getCompleteList
methods.description: Retrieves all remaining results as a list of GenericValue objects.

methods.name: getPartialList
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of results starting at a specific index.

methods.name: getResultsSizeAfterPartialList
methods.description: Estimates the total size of the result set.

methods.name: getResultSize
methods.description: Counts the total number of results via database query.
